# Vendored theme licensing

`jellybeans.toml` is copied from the helix editor's runtime
(https://github.com/helix-editor/helix, `runtime/themes/jellybeans.toml`),
which is licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0.

MPL-2.0 is a file-level copyleft: it applies to this file itself, not to
the rest of remax. The file is embedded in the binary verbatim as data
(a color palette read at startup), and any modification to it must be
published under MPL-2.0. The full license text is available at
https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/.

This mirrors the arrangement for the helix highlight queries — see
`vendor/grammars/QUERY-LICENSE.md`.
